callees.name: _is_test_file
callees.pre_condition: file_path is a relative or absolute file path string.
callees.post_condition: Returns True when the file is classified as a test file based on its path or name; returns False otherwise.

callees.name: _is_under_submodules
callees.pre_condition: file_path is a relative file path string. submodules is a list of subdirectory path strings, or None.
callees.post_condition: Returns True when submodules is None or file_path resides within at least one of the given submodule directories; returns False otherwise.

callees.name: _codegraph_functions_by_file
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a valid directory path. codegraph_langs is an iterable of language key strings recognized by CodeGraph.
callees.post_condition: Returns a dict mapping each normalized relative file path string to a dict of {function_name: function_source} extracted by CodeGraph static analysis for all supported files in proj_dir.

callees.name: _codegraph_legacy_coverage
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a valid directory path. current_codegraph is the dict returned by _codegraph_functions_by_file. codegraph_file_languages maps relative file paths to language keys.
callees.post_condition: Returns a dict mapping each normalized relative file path to a boolean indicating whether CodeGraph successfully indexed that file in the current revision.

callees.name: _codegraph_functions_at_revision
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a valid directory path within a git repository. old_commit_id is a valid commit identifier. codegraph_file_languages maps relative file paths to language keys.
callees.post_condition: Returns a tuple of (codegraph_dict, coverage_dict) for the given revision if CodeGraph can index it; returns None when indexing the revision fails.

callees.name: extract_functions_from_file
callees.pre_condition: file_path is an absolute path to an existing source file. lang_key is a recognized language key string.
callees.post_condition: Returns an iterable of (function_name, function_source) tuples for every function found in the source file, using language-specific extraction logic for the given lang_key.

callees.name: _normalized_relative_path
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a directory path. rel_path is a relative file path string.
callees.post_condition: Returns a normalized relative path string with forward-slash separators and no leading dots or redundant separators.
